==Overview==
=== Format ===
* 16 teams are divided into 4 seeding pools based on their average final place in 2024 Spring and Summer (if tied, higher place in Summer grants a higher pool)
* 4 groups of 4 teams
* Single round robin within groups
* Matches are best of five
** Matches use "Hard Fearless Draft", champions can only be picked once by either team during the series
** Side selection for game 1 is decided by a 1v1 match
*** A player can't play two 1v1 match consecutively.
* Top 2 teams of each group advance to [[LPL/2025 Season/Split 1 Playoffs|Playoffs]]
* {{TiebreakerRules|
:* If two teams have the same number of series won, ties will be broken by:
::# Game Differential
::# Head to Head record}}

* Teams that do not yet have a home venue will use Shanghai's LPL Stadium (League Arena) by default.
* "League Arena" is the new name of Hongqiao World IE Hub since.
* For Split 1, the Shenzhen home venue will be undergoing renovations, as such, [[Ninjas in Pyjamas.CN|Ninjas in Pyjamas]] will be playing their games from the Shanghai League Arena.<ref>[https://weibo.com/7441697087/P8iLXpMuo 2025LPL深圳NIP主场延期开放公告 ( (Chinese)] ''weibo.com''</ref>
